sections.heading: UP Scholarship application upload rules.
body: The UP scholarship portal (scholarship.up.gov.in) requires all supporting documents to be attached in PDF format under 200 KB. Oversized attachments block online submission and lead to student form rejections.

faq.q: What is the file size limit for UP scholarship portal?
faq.a: All document uploads on scholarship.up.gov.in must be under 200 KB in PDF format.
